Ο host επιλέγει ερωτήσεις, χρόνο, δυσκολίες, κατηγορίες, κάρτες και αποστολές. Κενή επιλογή καρτών ή αποστολών τις απενεργοποιεί. Η στρατηγική ενεργοποιεί αυτοπεποίθηση, σερί, κάρτες και αποστολές.

Goal: earn the most points!

Answer before time expires. Correct: 500 points + up to 500 speed bonus. Difficulty: Easy ×1 · Medium ×1.5 · Hard ×2.

With strategy: choose confidence ×1, ×2 or ×3. Wrong at ×2: −250; at ×3: −500. Totals floor at 0. Streaks of 3/5 correct: +10%/+15%.

Correct answers fill the card meter. Hold up to 2 cards and use each in its allowed window. Completed secret missions award +500.

The host chooses length, time, difficulty, categories, cards and missions. Empty card or mission selections disable them. Strategy enables confidence, streaks, cards and missions.

Team scores sum individual points. Ties use extra questions; fastest correct wins. Everyone, including the host, must select ✓ before starting.
